entry.title: New: Resolution 368 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES RELATING TO THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A CAFETERIA PLAN UNDER SECTION 125 OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a one year and six month agreement, with options to extend for four subsequent one-year periods, with an approximate annual cost of $12,000, to furnish and implement a cafeteria plan consisting of health insurance premiums to be designated by the County as eligible for inclusion and two flexible spending accounts.

Latest action: Council: Adopted Res. 368-25 & FC-97 - 11/5/2025
